duplicate_criterion_1_a_rule: SHA256 of json.dumps({element: percent for nonzero elements}, sort_keys=True), identical to build_A.py
duplicate_criterion_2_unified_numeric: unified 33-symbol element order (32 targets + O) with values rounded to 12 decimals, then SHA256; this also matches compositions that differ only by which elements happen to be zero
near_neighbour_rule: L-inf distance over the unified 33-element vector, nearest neighbour reported for every B recipe; merge threshold 0.10 points
matrix_separation_note: A balances on SiO2 with Fe2O3T 1-20 percent while B balances on Fe2O3T 40-75 percent, so an exact or near collision would itself be a design error; the distances are recorded anyway
action_for_A: this list is handed to A for the 5,000-row master merge; B does not modify any A recipe
